records.title: 10-K
records.text: Accordingly, year-over-year comparisons of total sales for the fourth quarter and full year are affected by an extra week of sales in fiscal 2023.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: However, for comparable sales, the Company is reporting on a comparable weeks basis (i.e. the 14 and 53 weeks ended February 3, 2024 compared with the 14 and 53 weeks ended February 4, 2023, respectively).

records.title: 10-K
records.text: We successfully managed our inventory levels, which were down 12.9% as compared to the end of fiscal 2022.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: For fiscal 2023, gross margin, inclusive of occupancy costs, was 48.4% compared to 49.9% for fiscal 2022.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: We continued to strengthen our financial position in fiscal 2023, as we generated cash flow from operations of $49.6 million and free cash flow of $32.2 million.
